overview_description.description:
Flipturn is a cloud-based EV charging management platform that gives fleet operators, property managers, and commercial businesses control over their charging infrastructure from a single dashboard. The platform connects to any OCPP-compliant charger regardless of manufacturer, manages energy costs with automated load balancing and demand charge mitigation, processes driver payments with no app required, and monitors charger health with AI-powered diagnostics. Flipturn supports OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1, OCPI 2.2.1 for roaming, and OpenADR 2.0b for utility demand response. A REST API provides programmatic access to session data, charger commands, and energy records. Telematics integrations with Geotab and Samsara enable vehicle-aware charging.

Backed by CRV and Accel, Flipturn serves Fortune 500 fleet operators, commercial property owners, and multifamily REITs across North America.
